query: What is required for a LTVP holder to work in Singapore?
reference_answer: LTVP/LTVP+ holders may only commence work after they are issued a valid Letter of Consent (LOC) from Ministry of Manpower, along with a valid LTVP. You may continue to work if you have been issued with a valid work pass from Ministry of Manpower separately.
answer: LTVP holders in Singapore require a Work Permit (WPN) or Employment Pass (E-Pass) to work legally. [Document 1]
